name: NimbusCMS.dev
description: The theme for nimbuscms.dev — plain PHP, one hand-written stylesheet, zero JavaScript, system fonts. It lives the site's own performance claim.

templates.layout: HTML shell; includes header and footer.
templates.header: Site header with the broom mark + wordmark and the main menu.
templates.footer: Footer with links and the page's own measured weight.
templates.entry: A prose/legal page (a `pages` entry) — a centered reading column.

specialization: entry-home renders the home singleton; add entry-docs / collection-docs for the docs surface.
